_meta.note: Open-licence landscape photos from Wikimedia Commons (retrieved via the Commons API). Only CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA files were used. Each photo's location was verified by its Commons geotag falling inside the approved MOSAIC landscape boundary (MOSAIC_catalog/boundaries/<CODE>.geojson), or by a clearly named place inside it. Images were resized to max 1200 px wide, re-encoded as progressive JPEG and stripped of EXIF. Credit the author and licence wherever a photo is shown.
